nextRuntime.scope: Package name/version and CLI entrypoint bytes only; transitive dependency integrity is not established.

contentConstraints.objectPremise: An illustrative physical bench apparatus, not a sheet or card metaphor. Piece count, geometry, colors, composition and mechanisms are not prescribed.

beatMeanings.meaning: Explain firmware and bring-up in ordinary language, introduce Ada's code-to-physical-check contribution and the question the ending will answer.
Use the explicitly illustrative Sleep, Measure, Transmit loop to explain power-state scheduling without inventing actual firmware topology, durations or measured values.
Connect a command, board response, fixture access and observation; keep Ada's firmware, scheduling and fixture separate from the colleague's PCB and analogue front end.
Measured sleep and transmit current plus an assumed reporting interval support a two-year projection. A separate bench run supports 72 hours observed, not the projection's validation.

Answer the opening through firmware/scheduling and the fixture connecting code to an observable check. Bound it to six bench-tested of forty assembled engineering samples, none sent to customers, and a preliminary emissions pass with full qualification unfinished.

forbiddenClaims: Ada designed the PCB or analogue front end.
Two years of runtime was measured or validated by the 72-hour run.
All forty samples were bench-tested, or any sample went to customers.
There was a field deployment, product launch or customer pilot.
Full qualification or certification was completed.
A debugging incident, its diagnosis, fix ownership or measured outcome is approved for publication.
Exact current values, interval, capacity, circuit detail, additional test counts or pass/fail counts were supplied.
An illustrative drawing is an actual photo, trace, circuit diagram, firmware specification or qualification report.
Scripted/browser checks establish real author approval, a physical-phone test or measured phone performance.
contentConstraints.note: The checker tests structure and capabilities, not these semantic meanings or pixel quality. Newly authored headings and prose are allowed. Normal desktop, phone and short modes use the engine's 3D scene; this is a diagnostic technical requirement, not a biographical fact. Static and failure modes preserve all five explanations.

provenance.authorization: Coordinator-authored fictional confirmation for preparation of one five-beat diagnostic, not real person testimony or paid-run authorization.
provenance.scope: Approved-story realization, not concept discovery, automatic activation, stop 4/5/6 completion, full journey, generality or actual author approval.

limits: Coordinator source and expectations must be frozen by the run harness before the actor starts. Outside-workspace paths alone are not a sandbox write barrier.
Dependency entrypoint hashes are recorded, not full dependency integrity. The harness must audit dependency and lockfile mutation separately.
Next build executes application configuration. Fixed typecheck and lint commands use coordinator-generated configuration independently of actor scripts.
Headless Chromium viewport checks do not prove physical-phone performance, custom-object quality, truth of claims or external-link availability.
Screenshots require human visual review. Text and scene markers alone cannot establish faithful formations or visually correct 3D.
Control state/image changes and motion positions measure observable response, not whether the intended 3D component responded correctly.
visualReview: unobserved: original pixels and semantic scene/control targets require separate review
